description: HSE approval date set to the v1 date (2017-10-23): no archived copy of v1 of this treatment regimen was found, but the regimen is listed on the NCCP breast regimens page on 2017-11-12 (https://web.archive.org/web/20171112233205/http://hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/breast/), before v2 of this treatment regimen was published (2018-03-16). The indication is present on 2019-07-18 in v2 (https://web.archive.org/web/20190718153214/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/breast/433-dose-dense-doxorubicin-cyclophosphamide-ac-60-600-14-day-followed-by-weekly-paclitaxel-80-and-weekly-trastuzumab-therapy-dd-ac-th-.pdf), which means that 00433:b was published alongside 00433:a in v1.
